winding-sync/l1.note: abundantjoe/winding-sync; generated from CT via structure tensor, no human labels upstream

winding-sync/bfs.note: BFS baseline on the same graph as winding-sync/l1

E1.note: pscamillo winding-ruler E1; calibrated on the paris 4 z10000-11000 window. Held-out lines outside that window are reported separately and are independent

E1/held-out.note: E1 restricted to pairs outside the z10000-11000 development window

iyan-constraint-chain.note: IyanDopico/vesuvius-sheet-tools; the chain descends from the same stitched labels that form the 1218 arm. Declared by the author, A7

winding-sync/l1@stride120.note: OUR variant of abundantjoe/winding-sync v0.2.0: identical code and solver, TracingConfig.seed_stride_um lowered from 260 to 120 um. Not the author's configuration and not to be reported as winding-sync itself (A11).

winding-sync/l1@stride160.note: OUR variant of abundantjoe/winding-sync v0.2.0: identical code and solver, TracingConfig.seed_stride_um lowered from 260 to 160 um. Not the author's configuration and not to be reported as winding-sync itself (A11).

winding-sync/bfs@stride160.note: BFS spanning-tree baseline (solve_bfs_tree) on the SAME graph as winding-sync/l1@stride160. Isolates solver from generator: identical seeds and constraints, only the reconciliation differs. Our stride variant per A11.
